signature: A static, fog-drowned countryside where metres-high wheat forms an endless labyrinth, one warping highway runs past a mossy wall under a steel net, rotten wooden houses watch from every hill, an engine is always coming and never arrives, and walking straight ahead brings you back to the same fields.

exits.method: Break weak back door of a house
exits.source_quote: she once again found herself within grassy fields leading to nowhere
exits.label: Forced the rotten back door and found yourself in the grassy fields again
exits.hint: Every hill has a house. Every house has a back door nobody can open properly.
exits.implemented_as: same-level loop: transitions.json gives no destination (to: null); the page says she 'once again found herself within grassy fields leading to nowhere', so the edge is routed back into this level's meadow arrival

notes: SOURCE: subsector of Level 9; titanic grassy fields and lonely roads ringed by forested hills; static, overcast, humid, foggy, weak light from the clouds; houses on hilltops, tiny, putrescent, wooden, drenched inside, full of utensils, furnishings and beams; a hallway ending in a bathroom with a commode below a casement onto huge trees that never move; metres-high wheat forming an endless labyrinth that diverges toward buildings; one single highway warping under the fog; its tar tires wanderers; a brittle moss-covered cobble and brick wall covered by a steel net on one side; roads without cars but an echo of engines approaching and never arriving; the fog as a blanket to hide under; forests that lead back to the fields; Möbius terrain with the outside visible only as a fuzzy image in the sky; nothing grows, fades or breaks down; no life forms; discovery via a darkened corner of the wheat; a back door with a frozen knob but weak, through which Cassidy found herself in grassy fields again. ADAPTATION: the Möbius terrain is a 384 m periodic torus (walking straight through the forest returns you to the same fields); the maze is a seeded 8 m-cell torus maze with extra loops; three hilltop houses per period, each with a plank loft over the front room; the highway is a sinuous curve per period with the wall on its west side; the tar lowers walk/sprint speed and drains stamina; the engine is a periodic swell capped far away (it ends sooner while you crouch in wheat, forest or away from the road); the back-door edge has no destination in transitions.json (to: null), so it is routed to this level's meadow arrival (from_L009_3) per the page's wording; a soaked sheet paraphrases the page's advice; house furniture beyond 'utensils, furnishings and beams' and the bathroom fixtures is ours. The playable world is a finite 5x5 window of 48 m chunks streamed around the player.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The engine is only heard; nothing ever appears on the road.
